Current Engram binary for pinned TermAl live runs, and the latest Engram install (Termal::Fable2; condensed again at revision 47, 2026-10-10 04:11Z; full history in revisions 1-46).

PIN RULE. A `live --engram-binary --engram-sha256` run uses the pinned binary until a run needs a newer one. The pin is still Engram 08a04e0 (w-63757ebca393): exe sha256 bcec822ae785fc97a16fcb66efae3f4205ded4f6cd6c60d33a29f008b7c23c13, build_fingerprint 081842231d48c5f4adac88d847e6098dc2b46ad5a66775171d07719327ca1eff; backup engram-20261005T183302Z-081842231d48.exe (install notice ebe242f7 #668). Re-pin only when a TermAl check needs newer behaviour. Any check pinned to an intermediate build must re-pin when that build is replaced. w-47338 will need an occurrence_id-capable pin (43f5cd8 or later) when its first stage tests.

LATEST INSTALL. 2026-10-10 04:09Z (ebe242f7 #1043): Engram 5da3a6e92b22, the task-data validation paragraph v3 in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (w-d0c2d08008ca; TermAl concurred and audited it; the landed files hash 716ec55a…, equal to the audited input). Docs only. Build 85dc894cb0585f2135ddd0aa6bc7f824ac932075e1cc93995b1a659e09c29e8d, exe sha256 31ca6704a8cf73a2b4a514104616be0a5c36ad8b1aa5ca1117b654484c159c6f; backup of 88eb96e3 (exe 363cfcdb) kept. No restart. Pins unaffected.

RECENT INSTALLS (all fast-forwards, gap-free swaps, no schema change unless noted; hashes in revisions 36-46):

- 2026-10-09 23:43Z b74711de (launcher tests and docs), 22:31Z 2de7a4b8 (unblock wording), 21:25Z 74566af4 (note write waits up to 10 s on a write lock, then a typed refusal; the "database is locked" phrase kept), 20:22Z 411f8a83 (BEHAVIOUR: request-decidable refusals of done, evaluate, update, propose and handoff no longer move focus), 17:35Z 4466cf6c (the launcher writes request.json `detached`, a stage `cwd`, and tests `runner: "node-test"` for focused node --test).

INSTALL-GAP INCIDENT, 2026-10-09 17:43Z: engram.exe was briefly absent during a swap (a 502 "failed resolving Engram program ... (os error 2)"). Engram uses gap-free swaps since then. If a host-side engram call fails with os error 2, check for an install in progress, then retry once.

RUNNING MCP SERVERS pick up a newer install only at the next TermAl restart (or when their session is recreated). A control sidecar picks it up after its idle reap.

BEHAVIOUR HISTORY SINCE THE PIN (details in revisions up to 25): 92fc3d0 atomic new-store open; 321b80a verification_bind; 47f3cff ancestor .engram-project search; 835c846 bare done/evaluate refused with several live claims; d8ec5a4 marker of at most 4096 bytes; 7b8d87e status-grouped verification view; 496ab34 ambiguity lists 3 refs; 86c82c8 citation refusal names the mismatch; 581bf6c extended-length paths; 8ca2538 refusal above 1024 prerequisites; 7306ac3 bare core-complete guard; 2026-10-06: 7340a47 and 6eff095 restore performance, 2f87464, 6679442 turn_grant_read (TermAl consumer w-f79e3484ac46 parked), 43f5cd8 required occurrence_id per restore (TermAl half w-4be3e96f76b8), a112b1f, ab55fda, 3f3f24be63a7 `unadmitted_change`; 2026-10-09: d7395955, 2e0091cf, 411f8a83, 74566af4, 2de7a4b8; 2026-10-10: beab5b8b, ea349bfc.

Report any reader mismatch on real records to Engram::Fable.
